# Kumquat

Kumquat sells 351 curated niche B2B business lists and Creator Intelligence datasets delivered as CSV files for sales outreach, market research, partnerships, sponsorship, software sales, agency prospecting, and business discovery.

## Core Pages

- Home: https://kumquat.info/
- Browse lists: https://kumquat.info/lists.html
- Curl-ready catalog JSON: https://kumquat.info/assets/products.json
- No-JavaScript catalog HTML: https://kumquat.info/agent-catalog.html
- Browser catalog renderer source: https://kumquat.info/assets/main.js
- Custom list request: https://kumquat.info/custom-list.html
- Compliance: https://kumquat.info/compliance.html
- AI agent skills: https://kumquat.info/skills.html
- Plain-text AI agent instructions: https://kumquat.info/skills.txt
- Contact: https://kumquat.info/contact.html

## What Kumquat Sells

Kumquat sells downloadable CSV business lists and Creator Intelligence datasets organized by niche, geography, industry, buyer type, and use case. Categories include Agent Stats, recently active, high-review website gap, AI automation opportunity, platform migration, website opportunity, software gap, ad spend signal, events and venues, professional services, real estate and property, Creator Intelligence, government and public organization, local sponsorship, and high-signal opportunity lists.

## Common Dataset Fields

Fields vary by product and may include business name, website, city, state, category, opportunity signal, phone number, public email, contact page, social link, landing page, source URL, last-verified date, creator_name, platform, profile_url, niche, follower_range, engagement_signal, brand_fit_score, local_relevance_score, contactability_score, activity_score, and notes.

## Delivery

After payment, Kumquat sends a download link by email once the dataset is available. Delivery can take a few seconds, up to 24 hours, or longer if manual review or processing is required.

## AI Agent Instructions

AI agents should read https://kumquat.info/skills.txt before assisting with purchase or download tasks. Browser-capable agents can browse https://kumquat.info/lists.html to compare product title, category, price, record count, expected fields, buyer use case, and checkout URL. Curl-only agents should fetch https://kumquat.info/assets/products.json. Agents without JavaScript can fetch https://kumquat.info/agent-catalog.html. If the generated catalog files are unavailable, agents can fetch https://kumquat.info/assets/main.js and parse the product objects used to render the browser catalog. Agents should not purchase without explicit buyer approval. After payment, agents should use the exact emailed download link and may download the CSV with: curl -L --fail --output kumquat-list.csv 'EMAIL_DOWNLOAD_URL'.

## Custom Lists

Kumquat accepts custom list requests through a paid deposit checkout. A useful request includes the niche or industry, city or region, target record count, required fields, budget, timeline, and examples of ideal businesses.

## Compliance

Kumquat focuses on public business websites, business contact pages, public company information, source URLs, and professional-use datasets. Buyers are responsible for following applicable email, privacy, advertising, and data laws, respecting opt-out requests, verifying data before use, and avoiding deceptive or abusive campaigns.

## Contact

For list questions, custom datasets, partnerships, bulk orders, delivery questions, or compliance questions, email info@athena.live.
